title: A dual-modality workflow for quantifying microvascular structure in human temporal lobe epilepsy.
snippet: Microvascular remodeling is implicated in the pathophysiology of drug-resistant temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE). However, characterizing these changes in adult human surgical tissue is methodologically limited by the accumulation of lipofuscin, an autofluorescent pigment that obscures microvascular structures and confounds standard automated quantification.
